camera: One front camera matched to the reference; every render is scored from it.

arms.name: Six crops
arms.how: Six parallel jobs. Each sees only its crop and models that sixth, then the parts are assembled.

arms.name: Full view, parallel
arms.how: Six parallel jobs. Each sees the whole figure but owns one chunk.

arms.name: Sequential, top down
arms.how: One chunk at a time, head to feet. Each job sees the full image and everything built so far.

arms.name: Feet up
arms.how: Sequential, starting from the feet so the stance sets the scale.

arms.name: Torso out
arms.how: Sequential, starting from the chest so the mass sets everything else.

arms.name: Face last
arms.how: Sequential, big masses first, then limbs, with the face and hands as the final detail pass.
